english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for speaking indistinctly and quietly, especially when complaining or annoyed.

examples.english: They mutter that I have to do everything again while clearing the table.
examples.traditional: 佢一邊執枱面，一邊咕噥住話又要我做晒啲嘢。
